title: International Yoga Day: State tells Calcutta HC employees were "requested" to participate to break record
description: The Calcutta High Court on Thursday asked the State government to respond to a petition challenging the mandated participation of employees in the International Yoga Day programme on June 21. Justice Amrita Sinha asked the State counsel to seek instructions and listed the matter for hearing on Friday.Justice Amrita SinhaThe State Coordination Committee of the West Bengal Government Employees has moved the Court challenging the West Bengal Chief Secretary's order asking all officers and employees
